subject: Re: Amulet connector — certification gaps & co-sell readiness
body:
From: Anna Patel <anna@amulet.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: co-sell certification for Amulet-Redwood connector

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the Redwood runtime looks like a great fit for our inference orchestration use case. We heard from a couple of joint prospects that having a published marketplace listing + co-sell badge would materially accelerate pipeline.

We’ve started compiling technical evidence for the listing and initial co-sell certification, but want to confirm what gaps Redwood needs to sign off on. Attached a short architecture diagram and our current security brief.

Attachments: amulet-connector-arch.pdf (diagram), amulet-security-brief.docx (security summary)

High-level asks:
- What evidence does Redwood require for co-sell (metering, billing integration, auth model)?
- Any specific SOC2/PCI/PHI evidentiary items beyond our doc?
- Recommended timeline for certification + published listing (we’re aiming for end of May).

Timothy Clark (procurement at BigRetail) is also on the thread since they asked for co-sell pricing guidance during the demo — his note is below if helpful.

Best,
Anna
Head of Partnerships, Amulet Analytics

----
From: Timothy Clark <timothy.clark@bigretail.com>
Sent: Mon, 1 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
To: Anna Patel <anna@amulet.ai>
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up

Anna — please share what the expected SKU/pricing is once you have Redwood co-sell support. Procurement will evaluate, thanks.


----------
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@amulet.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2029 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell certification for Amulet-Redwood connector

Hi Anna — thanks for sending these over and for looping Timothy.

We’re excited to pursue a co-sell listing. Quick answers up front:
- Minimum evidence set for Redwood marketplace co-sell: SOC2 report (if available), network/data flow diagram (you provided), evidence of tenant isolation (how credentials are scoped per customer), and a short metering/billing spec (how usage maps to SKUs).
- Additional items we often request: simple end-to-end demo recording showing the connector provisioning + one example joint-customer flow; a short runbook for common support escalations; sample logs or an access pattern doc (S3 paths, Pub/Sub topics, etc).
- Timeline: if you can target getting the evidence + demo to us in 3 weeks, we can run the internal checklist and aim to get listing-approved in ~4–5 weeks after that (fits your end-of-May objective).

Next steps I propose:
1) Amulet to provide a 20–30 minute screen-recorded provisioning demo and an updated evidence bundle by Tue 23 Apr.
2) Karthik will run the technical review for metering/billing mapping and confirm SKU guidance.
3) Ben will coordinate GTM/co-sell enablement (playbook + case study ask).

Ben/Karthik — can you confirm the internal owners and whether we need any additional compliance artifacts beyond SOC2? Ben, can you also flag whether we should require a minimum joint pipeline commitment for co-sell badge?

Anna — feel free to send your procurement pricing note (Timothy) and any DocuSign template you use for reseller/co-sell agreements.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell certification for Amulet-Redwood connector (internal)

Quick internal notes:
- Metering: we need a deterministic mapping from Amulet usage -> Redwood SKU units. If they route inference through our runtime, we can meter tokens; if they only list an orchestration integration, we need a usage proxy. Karthik, can you assess their arch diagram and confirm feasibility?
- Compliance: SOC2 is sufficient baseline for listing; for any customers requiring PHI/PCI we will need either a private deployment reference or an attestation. Ask them for the last SOC2 audit date and AICPA firm.
- Co-sell badge criteria: historically we require at least one joint customer reference or a pipeline commitment of $50k ARR to unlock co-sell priority. Recommend we present a flexible ramp: badge granted at approval + pilot cust commitment, escalated priority after signed joint customer.

I’ll draft the GTM checklist and a template ask list for Amulet to follow.

--Ben
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

----
From: Anna Patel <anna@amulet.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Clark <timothy.clark@bigretail.com>, Amulet Support <support@amulet.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: co-sell certification for Amulet-Redwood connector

Thanks Hannah and team — appreciate the clear checklist. Attached is an updated evidence bundle and a short provisioning demo recording link. We also included the SOC2 summary (last audit Dec 2028) and a sample metering spec.

Attachments: amulet-evidence-v2.zip (contains demo-link.txt, SOC2-summary.pdf, metering-spec.md)

DocuSign link for our co-sell agreement: https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-COSELL-001
Procurement contact Timothy (cc) — we’ve proposed a starter joint-pilot SKU with a $30k commitment; happy to discuss your $50k threshold and structure a ramp.

Next steps for us: please confirm receipt and share any immediate gaps by EOD Mon 8 Apr, and Karthik if you can flag any technical blockers on metering. We’re actively prioritizing this since we have a prospect in POC that would benefit from a published listing.

Best,
Anna
Head of Partnerships, Amulet Analytics

----
[End of thread]
